1.

How sweet Thy name, O Jesus, is To him who believes in Thee! It gives comfort in sorrow and care And grants me health.

2.

To the wounded soul it bears balm And calms the anxious breast, The hungry receives manna there, The weary rest and solace.

3.

O name, my rock, where I dwell, My shield, my hiding place, Thou! My treasure, of which with great joy I already now partake.

4.

My Lord, Thou who art for me My God, my Saviour, My help, my Priest, my beloved Shepherd, And my Defender!

5.

I will praise Thy precious name With every breath Now and hereafter in Thy embrace In the day of eternity.
